contract: Seven randomized mirrored ABBA/BAAB blocks. Same library/driver, fresh processes, two warmups and five measured GPU command timestamps. Every-cell independent dyadic checks and poison/guard checks every round outside timing. Preallocated shared inputs; excludes language scheduling/allocation and epilogue/reduction. Includes non-square, partial-tile and narrow admission boundaries. Not complete-pipeline throughput.
